about: Coldstream is a district municipality in British Columbia’s North Okanagan, surrounding and adjoining the City of Vernon—not Vernon itself. Orchards, ranchland, Kalamalka Lake shoreline, and rural residential neighbourhoods define this valley municipality. About 11,000 people live in Coldstream.
